TITLE: Offline/recovery UX and battery behavior
NOTES: Reviewed transport branch was not ported. Existing session restore and send path are unchanged.
Airplane, reconnecting, and exhausted backoff are distinct and truthful in the banner.
A recovered completed turn renders from the persisted row only, so it is shown once.
Every unfinished outbound stays visible until the existing send path finishes.
A foreground flip while backoff is already running does not open a second connect.
Notification dedupe status is shown only when the existing ledger already has entries.
